r8: When an obstacle (a car, a person, a rider or another obstacle) appears ahead, stop.
r13: When the traffic light ahead is red or yellow, stop.
r13b: When there is a stop sign ahead, stop.
r15: When the traffic light ahead is green, drive on; if there is an obstacle ahead, or possibly a pedestrian (30% confidence or more), stop.
r3: When a pedestrian may be ahead but it is uncertain (30–85% confidence), stop (cautious braking).
r28: When the left is blocked (no lane, an obstacle in the left lane, or a solid line), do not turn or change lanes to the left.
r29: When the right is blocked (no lane, an obstacle in the right lane, or a solid line), do not turn or change lanes to the right.
